meta_description: Step-by-step guides for beginners: update Betaflight on an OpenFC flight controller, read AM32 on an OpenESC, check it worked, and recover.
title: Firmware guides
lead: Step-by-step guides for updating the firmware on your OpenDrone boards, written for a first-timer. Where a step is not available yet, the guide says so. Every step says what you should see, and every page ends with what to do if it does not work.
flash_cta_note: The firmware page gives you the checked Betaflight file for your flight controller to drag onto the board, once it is released. ESC install is coming after bench verification.
flash_cta_note_direct: In Chrome or Edge, the firmware page installs Betaflight with one button: Update firmware. Copying the file onto the board is the fallback.
safety_points: Flight controller over USB: keep the flight battery unplugged.
ESC: plug the battery in only at the step that asks for it, and unplug it when you are done. Flashing an ESC from our page is not available yet.
Never unplug anything, close the tab or let the computer sleep while firmware is being written.
browser_points: Drag-and-drop update of the flight controller: any browser, on Windows, macOS or Linux.
The Betaflight app and reading ESCs: Chrome or Edge on a computer.
A USB-C cable that carries data, not a charge-only cable.
